scenes.title: Origins of Futures: Corn Farmer vs. Miller

beats.hindi_tts: फ्यूचर्स की शुरुआत शिकागो में मक्का किसानों और मिल मालिकों के बीच मूल्य जोखिम को संतुलित करने के लिए हुई थी।

beats.en_narration: Let us review the eight core principles and market mechanisms mastered in Chapter 1 Part 1.
beats.en_subtitle: Executive Summary: Eight core principles mastered in Chapter 1 Part 1.

steps: 1. Origins: Derivatives exist fundamentally to eliminate operational price risk, founded at 1848 CBOT.
2. Market Architecture: Standardized exchange futures (CME) feature daily margin; custom OTC forwards trade bilaterally.
3. Market Scale: The global OTC market ($630T notional) dwarfs exchange trading ($65T) by a 10:1 ratio.
4. Symmetrical Payoffs: Linear terminal payoffs are Long (Sₜ − K) and Short (K − Sₜ) with zero upfront cost.
5. Corporate Hedging: Importers lock costs buying at Offer; exporters lock revenues selling at Bid.
6. Leverage Fragility: At 31:1 leverage, Lehman's equity buffer was 3.23%; a tiny 3.23% drop caused insolvency.
7. Systemic Risk: Interconnected bilateral OTC exposures create domino default freezes across banking systems.
8. Post-2008 Reforms: Mandatory CCP novation, electronic SEF trading, and trade repository reporting restore stability.
